name: DragEngine
description:
Apply `drag force <http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Drag_equation>`__ on some particles at each step, decelerating them proportionally to their linear velocities. The applied force reads

.. math:: F_{d}=-\frac{\vec{v}}{|\vec{v}|}\frac{1}{2}\rho|\vec{v}|^2 C_d A

where $\rho$ is the medium density...

attributes.name: Rho
attributes.description: Density of the medium (fluid or air), by default - the density of the air.
